end.summary:
Practised marking unit fractions by splitting 0 to 1 into equal gaps.
Riya made 4 attempts without an unaided correct response.
Riya counted tick marks instead of equal gaps once when naming a fraction.
They identified the first mark as 1/4 after further prompting; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised dividing the interval from 0 to 1 into equal gaps and naming each point as a fraction. Riya engaged with the examples and later corrected the mix-up between a tick mark and the number of equal gaps by identifying the first mark as 1/4. At home, draw a line from 0 to 1 divided into 2, 3, and 4 equal gaps, and ask Riya to label the first point in each case.
